question.worked_solution:
First, note that $x=-6$ cannot be a solution since division by $0$ is undefined. 

To solve the equation, we first apply cross-multiplication:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{5}{4x+24} & =\frac{5}{x+6} \\ 5\cdot (x+6) & =(4x+24)\cdot 5 \\ 5x+30 & =20x+120\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we apply the addition and multiplication principles, as usual:

$$
\begin{aligned}5x+30 & =20x+120 \\ 5x+30-5x & =20x+120-5x \\ 30 & =15x+120 \\ 30-120 & =15x+120-120 \\ -90 & =15x \\ \frac{-90}{15} & =\frac{15x}{15} \\ -6 & =x\end{aligned}
$$

Since $x=-6$ cannot be a solution, the equation has no solutions.
